definitions.explanation: A round, short-legged crab covered in short bristly hair, caught mainly off Hokkaido and prized for its rich, sweet meat and roe.

examples.japanese: {毛蟹|けがに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧。
{毛蟹|けがに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}くて→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧だ。
examples.english: Horsehair crab meat is sweet and rich.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧のお⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{茹|ゆ}でた→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧{毛蟹|けがに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: As a souvenir from Hokkaido, I bought boiled horsehair crab.

notes:
{毛蟹|けがに} is named for the short brownish bristles (⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧, hair) covering its round shell, unlike the smooth-shelled ズワイ{蟹|がに} or タラバ{蟹|がに}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {茹|ゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{毛蟹|けがに}: boiled horsehair crab
- {毛蟹|けがに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蟹味噌|かにみそ}→蟹味噌：30911_kanimiso⟧: horsehair crab tomalley, considered especially good
